parent.title: A Modena weekend, anchored on a Michelin dinner

siblings.title: Things to do in Modena
siblings.summary: A 2-day Modena plan: UNESCO trio + Albinelli on day one around the Michelin dinner, Ferrari or acetaie on day two. Skip Sun/Mon if you can.

siblings.title: Michelin 2 and 3-star restaurants in Modena
siblings.summary: Modena has exactly one 2★-or-3★ Michelin restaurant — Osteria Francescana (3★). The 2-star tier is empty; nearest 2★ is San Domenico in Imola, ~1h drive.
